lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot intensity is highest in the mid-flank region with semi-regular spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity spots are centered at the intersections of faint vertical bands and horizontal carinae, creating a series of node-like features across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct elongated objects (commensal fish) positioned ventrally to the main pectoral fin silhouette.
